mapper.sql: menu_id, role_id, menu_code, menu_name, route_path, sort_no, enabled
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.role_id, m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.route_path, m.sort_no, m.enabled FROM menu m JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = m.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.enabled = TRUE AND m.menu_id = ( SELECT MIN(m2.menu_id) FROM menu m2 JOIN user_role ur2 ON ur2.role_id = m2.role_id WHERE ur2.user_id = #{userId} AND m2.route_path = m.route_path AND m2.enabled = TRUE ) ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.menu_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND menu_code = #{menuCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu (role_id, menu_code, menu_name, route_path, sort_no, enabled) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{menuCode}, #{menuName}, #{routePath}, COALESCE(#{sortNo}, 0), COALESCE(#{enabled}, TRUE))
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
